title: Payload check
author: Iced-Cream
description: A test for core-a4mk2 0.6's payloads and its 37.7 MB mods' area on the Analog Four MKII: a 512 KB payload of a known pattern found through core_payload and read back whole every 10 s, and an 8 MB .bss array filled with a pattern and read back round and round. Where each part landed and the counts are in RAM after the magic PKC1; a square at the bottom right while all reads back right.
